Film4.uk.title: Braveheart
Film4.uk.description: (1995) Mel Gibson stars in this Oscar-laden epic as William Wallace - Scottish freedom fighter, rousing orator and keen face painter - who led his army into England, threatening the throne.

Film4.uk.title: The Mission
Film4.uk.description: (1986) Award-winning epic with Robert De Niro and Jeremy Irons. A Jesuit priest and a reformed slave trader forge an alliance to protect Indigenous South Americans from colonial Portugal.

Film4.uk.title: Teleshopping
Film4.uk.description: Teleshopping.

Film4.uk.description: Teleshopping.

Film4.uk.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
Film4.uk.description: (1943) Drama. Director Sam Wood's epic adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's classic story about the Spanish Civil War. Starring Oscar-nominees Gary Cooper and Ingrid Bergman.

Film4.uk.title: Imitation of Life
Film4.uk.description: (1959) Lana Turner and Oscar-nominated Juanita Moore star in Douglas Sirk's classic melodrama, which explores race relations and mother-daughter relationships. Contains racist language.

Film4.uk.title: Patrick
Film4.uk.description: (2018) Feel-good British family comedy. Sarah's (Beattie Edmondson) chaotic life gets even more complicated when she inherits a naughty pug from her nan.

Film4.uk.title: Bridge of Spies
Film4.uk.description: (2015) Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance star in Steven Spielberg's Cold War spy drama. After gaining notoriety for defending a Soviet spy, a US lawyer then tries to free a CIA pilot.

Film4.uk.title: Eileen
Film4.uk.description: (2023) Anne Hathaway plays a dazzling psychologist who rocks anonymous Thomasin McKenzie's drab, 1960s smalltown world to precariousness, in William Oldroyd's sultry psychological thriller.

Film4.uk.title: Predator
Film4.uk.description: (1987) Sci-fi thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. A US commando unit gets trapped in the jungle by a murderous, seemingly invincible alien hunter. But they ain't got time to bleed.

Film4.uk.title: Let Him Go
Film4.uk.description: (2020) Neo-western with Kevin Costner. After losing their only son, a retired sheriff and his wife try to save their former daughter-in-law from her abusive partner.

Film4.uk.description: Teleshopping.

Film4.uk.description: Teleshopping.

Film4.uk.title: Warlock
Film4.uk.description: (1959) Western starring Henry Fonda. A gunfighter is hired to protect a town from a raiding gang. But a vendetta could undermine him. With Anthony Quinn, Richard Widmark and Dorothy Malone.

Film4.uk.title: Gunman's Walk
Film4.uk.description: (1958) Western. Van Heflin stars as a veteran frontiersman whose determination to mould his sons in his gun-totin' image backfires disastrously. With Tab Hunter and James Darren.

Film4.uk.title: The Gunfighter
Film4.uk.description: (1950) Western. Gregory Peck stars as Jimmy Ringo, an ageing gunslinger searching for his estranged wife and son. But he's constantly impeded by the young bucks who are out to gun him down.

Film4.uk.title: Arizona Raiders
Film4.uk.description: (1965) William Whitney's brutal western. Two former Confederate rebels are offered their freedom if they can track, catch or even kill their former gang mates. Starring Audie Murphy.

Film4.uk.title: Behind Enemy Lines
Film4.uk.description: (2001) Thriller with Owen Wilson. A US Navy flight officer on a NATO reconnaissance mission has to fend for himself when he's shot down by Serb forces in the former Yugoslavia. Violence.

Film4.uk.title: Wrath of Man
Film4.uk.description: (2021) Jason Statham reunites with director Guy Ritchie to give it both barrels as a mysterious hardman working for a money truck firm that keeps getting hit. Is he an inside man?

Film4.uk.title: Tombstone
Film4.uk.description: (1993) Western. Kurt Russell stars in the story of legendary Wild West lawman Wyatt Earp told through the medium of the moustache. With Val Kilmer as 'Doc' Holliday and Charlton Heston.

Film4.uk.title: Better Things
Film4.uk.description: (2008) Stark drama. Young villagers in the Cotswolds turn to heroin to fill their empty days and empty lives. Sexual scenes/strong language/hard drug use.

Film4.uk.description: Teleshopping.

Film4.uk.description: Teleshopping.

Film4.uk.title: Halls of Montezuma
Film4.uk.description: (1951) Second World War drama. Richard Widmark stars as a commanding officer leading US Marines into the Pacific to capture Japanese prisoners and discover the location of a rocket base.

Film4.uk.title: All That Heaven Allows
Film4.uk.description: (1955) Romantic drama with Jane Wyman and Rock Hudson. A wealthy widow decides to restart her life. But her children and her social set disapprove of her lover, forcing her to rethink.

Film4.uk.title: Lifeboat
Film4.uk.description: (1944) Alfred Hitchcock's Oscar-nominated Second World War drama starring Tallulah Bankhead, William Bendix and Walter Slezak as three of the survivors from a liner torpedoed by the Nazis.

Film4.uk.title: Sea Wife
Film4.uk.description: (1957) Offbeat melodrama starring Richard Burton (as an RAF officer), Joan Collins (as a nun), Basil Sydney and Cy Grant, who end up on a life raft together after their ship is torpedoed.

Film4.uk.title: Wild Horse Nine Interview Special
Film4.uk.description: Writer/director Martin McDonagh and cast discuss the Film4-produced political comedy thriller Wild Horse Nine.

Film4.uk.title: Twister
Film4.uk.description: (1996) Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton and Philip Seymour Hoffman star in writer Michael Crichton's tornado-chasing action adventure about a bunch of clever misfits hunting the perfect storm.

Film4.uk.title: Commando
Film4.uk.description: (1985) Thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger. To free his kidnapped daughter, an ex US commando must agree to assassinate a South American president. But he's not as pliant as he seems...

Film4.uk.title: X
Film4.uk.description: (2022) Ti West's acclaimed grindhouse horror with Mia Goth. Some adult filmmakers inexplicably choose a ramshackle house in the Bible-Belt wilderness to shoot a film. It's gonna get nasty.
